messages:
Kai D: Heads up — our strict fncall validator canary in us-west started rejecting ~0.8% of traffic after the 02:10 deploy. Mostly tool_output shape diffs.
Nina H: Saw that. Canary slice is 5% of traffic, reject spike makes it look like full rollout would be disruptive.
infra-bot: Alert: canary_fncall_reject_rate (us-west) > 0.5% for 5m. https://console/redwood/alerts/cc123
Omar S: Pasting anonymized failing example: 
```json
{"req_id":"r1","tool_output":{"items":[{"text":"ok"}]}}
```
Omar S: Validator expected tool_output to be object with meta field. Model variant emits minimal list occasionally.
Lena P: Question: is this model decode noise or SDK serialization mismatch?
Kai D: Early sampling shows two partner SDKs plus internal test harness. Looks like SDKs serializing arrays sometimes.
Nina H: For the canary, suggestion: rollback validator strictness for that slice OR enable soft-validate per-account while we patch SDKs. Which is faster?
Omar S: Easiest: flip canary flag to soft-validate=true for us-west canary. That avoids routing to degen and reduces user-visible errors.
Kai D: Agreed but we must ensure telemetry marks these as soft_coerce so they don't count as hard fallbacks. Ops needs split for billing and SLA.
Lena P: We don't currently emit validation_kind in the canary traces. Can we add a quick trace tag validation_kind=soft|hard on the runtime toggle? Low-risk codepath.
Nina H: Also raise sampling for validation failures in the canary from 1% -> 20% for 1h so we can capture full model_decodes and sdk payloads.
infra-bot: Executing: set flag canary.validation.soft=true; increase validation sampling for canary to 20% for 60m.
Omar S: After flip: reject rate dropped from 0.8% -> 0.05% in 6m. Captured 14 full decode samples.
Kai D: Postmortem actions: 1) add metric fncall_validation_kind with values [hard,soft,coerce]; 2) add console widget showing top mismatched fields per route; 3) update SDK docs and release patch to normalize tool_output union.
Lena P: I'll own the console widget RFC. Nina will coordinate billing semantics with finance.
Nina H: Looping finance. We need decision: soft-validated requests billed at full price or discounted when not routed to actual tool execution?
Kai D: Interim billing policy: if route != executed_tool, mark as discounted; we'll finalize EOD.
Omar S: PR for soft-validate toggle + trace tag: https://git/redwood/pulls/4602
Nina H: Monitoring will continue for 1h. Leaving thread open. :white_check_mark:
